scope: Future controller census serialization only; no runtime, assertion, timeout, filter, or platform selection change
observed_execution: Join actual module outcome rows to the derived source sets; report executed/ignored/unrun independently. A source catalog is never itself execution evidence.
checks: Catalog sets are disjoint where declared and reconstruct original platform catalogs.
Observed Mac Reader identities match the actual compiled inventory; each outcome occurrence remains retained.
Ignored DAC identities cannot acquire ordinary runtime credit.
Derive counts from actual current source and inventory, never hardcode 3/12/1/1.
historical_compatibility: Never rewrite an existing receipt. Preserve the legacy field as a source catalog if present and add corrected categories in new receipts or explicit additive post-run clarifications.
